question: _______ is a traditional tribal dance performed mainly by the women of Jharkhand during the cultivation season.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhumur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jhumair or Jhumar** is an Indian folk dance.
 
• It originated in the Indian states of** Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, and West Bengal.**
 
• It is a folk dance of **Sadan, the Indo-Aryan ethnic group of Chotanagpur.**
 
• It primarily takes place during the** harvest season.**
 
• **The Mandar, Dhol, Nagara, and Bansuri** are the musical instruments employed.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yakshagana**:

 
 
• A dance-drama from **South India** is called **Yakshagana**.
 
• It has the** strongest ties** to the state of **Karnataka.**
 
 
 
• **Verdigao Dance:**
 
 
• Verdigao dance is the traditional dance form of** Daman and Diu, India. **
